title: Balance Sheet
intro: Financial position at a point in time (USD). Net profit for the selected month flows into equity and links to the Profit / Loss report for the same period. Past dates are recalculated from transactions recorded on or before that date.

balanceCheck.unbalanced: Balance check: Assets and liabilities + equity differ by {{diff}}. This can happen when accrual P&L and point-in-time ledger positions use different timing; review notes below.

assets.title: Assets
assets.productReceivables: Product receivables (prepaid orders, goods in transit)
assets.fixedAssetReceivables: Fixed asset receivables (paid, not yet received)
assets.courierCash: Cash with courier (collected, not handed in)

periodLock.title: Closed books
periodLock.closedThrough: Closed through {{date}} — money cannot be dated on or before it.
periodLock.nothingClosed: No month has been closed. Money may be dated to any past day.
periodLock.hint: Money dated on or before this day is refused unless you hold the right to post into a finished month, and every such entry is recorded with its reason.
periodLock.reasonRequired: Say why the line is moving — it stays on the record.
periodLock.confirmReopen:
Reopen the books from {{from}} back to {{to}}?

Months that have already been reported become writable again. This is kept on the record with your reason.
periodLock.errSave: Could not change the closed date.
